title: 2026–27 application window and portal entry point
requirement: Whether the AY 2026–27 application window is open and which portal entry point applies
rationale: No reviewed source states that a 2026–27 window is open or names an entry point for that cycle.
notes: The correct answer is 'not found in the sources reviewed', not 'does not exist'.

title: Three different 2026–27 closing dates from three guides
rationale: Three secondary guides state 31 October, 30 September and 25 October 2026. Context may explain the difference (different stages), so the correct label is conflicting/uncertain, not 'wrong'.

title: Scheme sanction recorded as ending in March 2026
requirement: Whether the scheme itself is sanctioned and current for AY 2026–27
rationale: The only approval period found ends in March 2026 or on earlier review, so the evidence describes an earlier period.

title: Only 2025–26 institute and state deadlines were found
requirement: Closing dates for institutes and state nodal agencies in AY 2026–27
rationale: The captured schedule is for 2025–26. It is evidence of the previous cycle, not of the target cycle.

title: Renewal document set is only partly stated
requirement: Required documents for fresh and renewal applications
rationale: An income certificate is stated for fresh applicants and a renewal certificate is mentioned, but no complete renewal document list exists in the reviewed material.

title: Renewal thresholds stated but not restated for the target cycle
requirement: Renewal conditions in the target cycle
rationale: The 50% marks / 75% attendance thresholds are established for the guidelines' period, but no reviewed document restates them for 2026–27.
